name: Residual Momentum
description: Blitz, Huij & Martens (2011). Ranks assets by beta-adjusted residual return (market-model residuals from regressing on IWRD benchmark) rather than total return. Monthly rebalance. Selects top 40% by residual momentum score (mean residual / std, information-ratio scaled), equal-weighted among held. Long-only. Reduces momentum volatility and drawdowns by isolating behavioural underreaction while neutralising incidental factor exposure.
